description: The pie chart, titled "Stimulus Type," illustrates the distribution of various types of stimuli used in developing story case studies related to generative AI in journalism. The chart is divided into eight distinct segments, each representing a different stimulus type with its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is "Draft/Other," accounting for 26.4% of the total, followed by "Press Release" at 18.7% and "External News Article" at 18.1%. Other notable categories include "Interview" at 8.8%, "Organizational Report" at 7.7%, and "Event Posting" at 6.6%. Smaller segments include "Organizational Website" and "Intra-agency news article," both at 4.9%, "Email" at 2.7%, and "Social Media Post" at 1.1%. Each segment is color-coded and labeled with its respective category and percentage, providing a clear visual representation of the relative frequency of each stimulus type. The chart effectively highlights the dominance of draft/other and press release stimuli in the context of these case studies.
